label: Name Keychain

line2.label: Line 2
line2.help: A second line. Leave blank for one line.

emboss.label: Raised text
emboss.help: 1 = text sticks out of the surface, 0 = text is cut into it. Raised text is easier to print and to colour differently.

th.label: Thickness
th.help: How thick the plate is. 3–4 mm is sturdy for a tag or keychain.

text_size.label: Max text size
text_size.help: Cap on letter height. Text is shrunk automatically if it doesn't fit, so this is a maximum, not a fixed size.

line_gap.label: Line spacing
line_gap.help: Vertical gap between lines. Reduced automatically if the lines won't fit.

pad_x.label: Side padding
pad_x.help: Clear space left and right of the text.

pad_y.label: Top/bottom padding
pad_y.help: Clear space above and below the text.

emblem_snap.label: Emblem position
emblem_snap.help: Snap the emblem to a spot on the plate. Choose 'custom' to place it by hand with the X/Y values below.

emblem_autocenter.label: Auto-centre emblem
emblem_autocenter.help: 1 = centre it exactly when position is 'center'.

emblem_scale.label: Emblem size
emblem_scale.help: Scale factor for the uploaded SVG. 0.25 = quarter size.

emblem_x.label: Emblem X
emblem_x.help: Left/right position. Only used when Emblem position is 'custom'.

emblem_y.label: Emblem Y
emblem_y.help: Up/down position. Only used when Emblem position is 'custom'.

emblem_mode.label: Raised emblem
emblem_mode.help: 1 = emblem sticks out, 0 = it's cut into the surface.

emblem_depth.label: Emblem height
emblem_depth.help: How far the emblem stands out of (or cuts into) the surface.

description: Rounded-rectangle keychain with your name and a ring hole.
